description: This file declares the HandleBusMessage class, which is a task for handling GStreamer bus messages within the WebAudio component of the Rialto media server. It includes class members, constructor, destructor, and an execute method, and references several external interfaces and classes.

classes.name: HandleBusMessage
classes.description: A class representing a task to handle GStreamer bus messages for WebAudio playback, encapsulating context, player, client, and message handling logic.

methods.name: HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with context, player, client, wrappers, and message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to handle the GStreamer bus message.
